scope: part one refutes the 2r law on the degree-capped class; part two is evidence on the linear class, where the law is a theorem

checks.name: the refuting probe is legal: sup-norm one, and degree two, which is at most r-1 for r = 3 -- so it lies in the degree-capped class an earlier version of this script used
E[chi g^2] = 1/2 exactly: squaring a degree-2 probe RECREATES the degree-3 tail character, which is what the degree cap was supposed to exclude
E_+[Y^3] - E_-[Y^3] = 3 h^2 exactly at every h, so a bounded statistic already separates the worlds at order h^2
the Cauchy-Schwarz bound (E_P f - E_Q f)^2 <= 4 H^2 (E_P f^2 + E_Q f^2) with f = Y^3 is satisfied, and its right-hand side is itself Theta(h^4)

REFUTATION: on the degree-capped class the measured order is near four and strictly below 2r = 6, so no uniform H^2 <= C h^6 can hold there.  A local search returns a value ATTAINED by a legal probe, so it is a LOWER bound on the supremum -- which is exactly the direction that can refute an upper-bound law
checks.detail: fitted order 3.937 < 6; H^2/h^4 settles at 1.7512e-02 while H^2/h^6 diverges to 2.1620e+00

checks.name: on the LINEAR class the identification order is no shallower than 2r at every r measured, so the ascent fails to refute the law there -- the direction a lower bound on the supremum can speak to
the decision direction stays at order two on the same class, which is the separation the paper claims

the exhibited constant is fitted on the COARSE half of the grid and validated on the FINE half -- not re-checked at the points that defined it -- and does NOT exceed it -- an UPPER-envelope test only, with no lower side: a ratio well below one means the measured order exceeds 2r, not that the constant is wrong
checks.detail: r=2: C=1.559e-02, worst out-of-sample ratio 1.092; r=3: C=8.894e-04, worst out-of-sample ratio 1.086

checks.name: the quadrature reproduces total mass one on both mixtures
every reported value beats both the zero probe and the best random draw, so the ascent improved on its own baselines
every reported value is at least a hundred times the quadrature's own noise floor, so the measured orders are not an artefact of the grid
REMOVING every class restriction destroys the separation -- the unrestricted class reaches a strictly shallower order -- so the restriction is load-bearing and not a convenience
checks.detail: r=2: linear 3.79 vs unrestricted 1.67; r=3: linear 5.80 vs unrestricted 1.66

checks.name: where the local ascent fails to improve on its best seed is RECORDED per h, so a fitted order through search-limited points is not presented as evidence for an optimum law
checks.detail: r=2: 6 of 6 h-values search-limited; r=3: 6 of 6 h-values search-limited
